description: Troubleshooting flowchart for diagnosing out-of-specification engagement force during a small-part assembly operation.

box_1.text: Record the batch number of the marked parts and the measured engagement force.

box_2.text: Is the insertion depth still within specification?

box_3.text: Take a sample of insertion depth

box_4.text: Adjust the press depth setting and repress the part to achieve the specified insertion depth.

box_5.text: Is the reduced engagement force present at multiple positions?

box_6.text: Have maintenance team check the part placement/pressing station (e.g. part placement positions, or air pressure)

box_7.text: Try a different batch of marked parts.

box_8.text: Does the pressed marked part contain visual defects?

box_9.text: Check the pin of the pressed marked part.

box_10.text: No visual defects detected, proceed to inspect the press fit interface for dimensional deviations.

box_11.text: Does the press fit interface contain dimensional deviations?

box_12.text: Inspect the press fit interface for dimensional deviations.
